title: Supreme Court Denies 9/11 Mastermind's Bid to Revive Plea Deal
detail: The US Supreme Court declined a bid by the accused 9/11 mastermind to revive his plea deal, leaving the Guantanamo military commission case without the agreement.

title: Mahmoud Khalil Asks Supreme Court to Review Deportation and Free Speech Case
detail: Palestinian activist Mahmoud Khalil petitioned the US Supreme Court to review his deportation case, which raises free speech claims.
